description: End-to-end incident management workflow for TaaS connectivity and cloud exchange services, covering detection, triage, impact analysis, mitigation, change coordination, communication, resolution, and post-incident review.

incident_id.description: Unique identifier for an incident in the incident management system.

service_id.description: Identifier for a TaaS or cloud exchange service (e.g., virtual circuit, interconnect, peering).

customer_id.description: Identifier for the customer affected by an incident.

ticket_id.description: Identifier for an external or integrated support ticket associated with an incident.

change_request_id.description: Identifier for a change request raised to implement mitigation or permanent fix.

timeline_entry_id.description: Identifier for a specific timeline or event entry within an incident.

communication_id.description: Identifier for a customer or stakeholder communication record.

functions.name: create_incident
functions.description: Create a new incident record based on detected or reported issues in the TaaS cloud exchange environment.

reported_by.description: Information about who or what reported the incident.

id.description: Identifier of the reporter (e.g., user ID, system name).

initial_summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the issue.

detailed_description.description: Detailed description of symptoms and observations.

affected_scope.description: Scope of impact across services and locations.

geography.description: Regions or metros where impact is observed.

estimated_affected_customers.description: Rough estimate of affected customers if known.

detected_metrics.description: Metrics that triggered the incident or were observed at creation time.

threshold.description: Configured threshold for this metric if applicable.

tags.description: Arbitrary key/value tags for classification and search.

functions.returns: Newly created incident_id, initial status, timestamps, and normalized severity.

functions.name: get_incident
functions.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific incident, including optional related entities.

incident_id.description: Identifier of the incident to retrieve.

include.description: Related resources to include in the response.

expand_levels.description: Depth of nested expansion for related entities (e.g., nested changes and communications).

functions.returns: Complete incident record with optionally expanded related entities and current status.

functions.name: list_incidents
functions.description: List and filter incidents across the TaaS cloud exchange environment with pagination and sorting.

has_open_changes.description: Filter for incidents that have active change requests.

text_search.description: Full-text search over summary and description.

tags.description: Tag filters; all specified tags must match.

functions.returns: Paginated list of incidents with summary fields and pagination metadata.

functions.name: update_incident_status
functions.description: Update core fields of an incident such as status, severity, ownership, and high-level attributes.

status_reason.description: Explanation for status or severity change.

expected_resolution_time.description: Updated ETA for mitigation or resolution.

functions.returns: Updated incident snapshot including new status, severity, and ownership.

functions.name: analyze_incident_scope
functions.description: Analyze and refine the scope of an incident by checking impacted services, regions, and customers.

analysis_inputs.description: Optional hints or overrides for analysis.

suspected_root_causes.description: List of suspected root cause categories.

candidate_services.description: Candidate services to prioritize in analysis.

include_historical_incidents.description: Whether to incorporate historical similar incidents in analysis.

analysis_depth.description: Depth and cost of the analysis to be performed.

functions.returns: Computed impact scope including impacted services, regions, customers, and confidence scores.

functions.name: validate_connectivity_and_paths
functions.description: Run connectivity and path validation tests for services related to an incident.

endpoints.description: Optional override endpoints for targeted tests.

destination.description: Destination IP, hostname, or agent ID.

run_async.description: If true, run tests asynchronously and return a tracking handle.

functions.returns: Connectivity test results or async job handle, including per-service health indicators and anomalies.

functions.name: link_services_and_customers_to_incident
functions.description: Associate additional services and customers with an ongoing incident based on analysis or reports.

impacted_entities.description: Entities to be linked as impacted by this incident.

reason.description: Explanation for adding these entities to the incident scope.

notify_existing_communications.description: If true, update open customer communications with expanded scope.

functions.returns: Updated incident impact scope with confirmation of linked services and customers.

functions.name: propose_and_initiate_mitigation_change
functions.description: Generate a mitigation plan and create an associated change request for implementing configuration or routing changes.

target_services.description: Services on which the mitigation change will operate.

target_path_profile.description: Desired routing/path profile identifier after change.

constraints.description: Constraints that must be satisfied by the mitigation.

execution_window.description: Requested time window for change execution.

risk_assessment.description: Risk assessment for the mitigation change.

fallback_plan.description: Plan for reverting if the mitigation fails or worsens impact.

requires_approval.description: Whether a human approval is required before executing this change.

functions.returns: Created change_request_id, proposed actions, and current approval/execution status.

functions.name: retry_or_rollback_change_for_incident
functions.description: Retry a failed mitigation change or roll back a previously applied change associated with an incident.

change_request_id.description: Identifier of the change request to act on.

action.description: Whether to reattempt the change or revert it.

reason.description: Explanation for retrying or rolling back.

retry_parameters.description: Parameters that apply when action is 'retry'.

rollback_options.description: Options that apply when action is 'rollback'.

rollback_to_version.description: Configuration version or snapshot ID to revert to.

preserve_current_metrics.description: If true, do not reset monitoring baselines on rollback.

force.description: If true, bypass non-critical validations when executing retry/rollback.

functions.returns: Updated change request status, execution result summary, and any new rollback/rollback_attempt identifiers.

functions.name: record_incident_timeline_entry
functions.description: Append a structured timeline entry to an incident, capturing key events, decisions, and actions.

timestamp.description: Time of the event; defaults to now if omitted.

actor.description: Entity responsible for this timeline entry.

details.description: Optional detailed description for the event.

related_entities.description: References to related entities (services, changes, communications).

relationship.description: Nature of the relationship (e.g., affected_by, triggered, refers_to).

visibility.description: Whether this entry can be shared externally.

functions.returns: Created timeline_entry_id and updated incident timeline summary.

functions.name: send_incident_communication
functions.description: Create and optionally send customer or stakeholder communications for an incident.

customer_ids.description: Explicit customers to notify (when type is specific_customers).

segment_filters.description: Filters for building a custom audience.

template.description: Optional template to use when generating content.

content.description: Raw content, used when no template is specified or as an override.

link_to_timeline.description: If true, create a timeline entry referencing this communication.

functions.returns: Created communication_id, delivery status (queued/sent), and any errors for individual recipients if applicable.

functions.name: resolve_and_close_incident
functions.description: Mark an incident as resolved and optionally closed, recording resolution details and root cause.

resolution_summary.description: Short description of what resolved the incident.

resolution_details.description: Detailed explanation including specific changes, vendors, and timelines.

post_incident_actions.description: Follow-up actions like RCAs, problem records, and reviews.

final_status.description: Target final status, default resolved if omitted.

notify_customers.description: If true, trigger resolution communication to impacted customers.

functions.returns: Updated incident with status resolved/closed, embedded root cause, and any follow-up task identifiers.

functions.name: cancel_incident
functions.description: Cancel an incident that was opened in error or superseded by another incident.

merged_into_incident_id.description: If duplicate, the primary incident_id this one is merged into.

notes.description: Additional context for auditing and reporting.

preserve_links.description: If true, maintain references from related tickets/changes to this cancelled incident.

functions.returns: Confirmation of incident cancellation, updated status, and any merge relationships.

functions.name: bulk_import_incidents
functions.description: Bulk-import multiple incidents from an upstream source with validation and idempotency keys.

mapping.description: Field mapping from source to canonical schema

functions.returns: A bulk-import job descriptor with counts of accepted, rejected, and quarantined incidents, plus a job_id for follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_update_incidents
functions.description: Apply a partial update to a batch of incidents matched by filter or id list.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

patch.description: Fields to patch on each matched item

functions.returns: Summary of matched, updated, and skipped incidents with per-item error details.

functions.name: bulk_archive_incidents
functions.description: Archive (soft-delete) a batch of incidents with retention metadata and audit reasons.
functions.returns: Per-id archive results with new lifecycle state.

functions.name: bulk_export_incidents
functions.description: Export a filtered set of incidents to a downstream destination (S3, GCS, blob, SFTP).

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Export job handle including job_id, expected object URIs, row count, and signed download URLs when applicable.

functions.name: search_incidents_advanced
functions.description: Advanced faceted search across incidents with full-text, structured filters, aggregations, and sort.

query.description: Full-text query string with Lucene-like syntax

functions.returns: Search response with incidents hits, total count, aggregation buckets, and a next-cursor.

functions.name: create_incident_subscription
functions.description: Create a subscription that fires webhooks or notifications on incident lifecycle events.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created subscription including subscription_id, active state, and last_delivery info (initially null).

functions.name: list_incident_subscriptions
functions.description: List existing incident subscriptions with optional filters and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscription objects including delivery health stats.

functions.name: deactivate_incident_subscription
functions.description: Deactivate or delete a incident subscription and optionally flush pending deliveries.
functions.returns: Updated subscription state and the number of pending deliveries flushed or kept.

functions.name: get_incident_audit_log
functions.description: Return the audit/change log for a single incident with field-level diffs and actor info.

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Chronological list of audit events with before/after diffs, actor, and source IP/system.

functions.name: search_audit_events
functions.description: Search audit events across incidents for compliance and forensic review.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated audit-event hits with cross-entity references.

functions.name: schedule_incident_job
functions.description: Create a recurring schedule that triggers a named operation on a target set of incidents.

operation.description: Named operation to invoke (e.g., refresh, recompute, export, reconcile)

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created scheduled-job descriptor with job_id, next_run_at, and current status.

functions.name: list_incident_jobs
functions.description: List scheduled or in-flight jobs related to incidents with status filtering and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of incident jobs and their last run summaries.

functions.name: cancel_incident_job
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-flight incident job, optionally interrupting running steps.
functions.returns: Updated job status with cancellation timestamp and any side effects.

functions.name: simulate_incident_change
functions.description: Simulate a proposed change against a incident (or batch) without committing; returns expected diffs and warnings.
functions.returns: Simulation result with predicted diffs, rule violations, cost/SLA impact, and a confidence score.

functions.name: request_incident_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a sensitive incident change requiring reviewer sign-off.
functions.returns: Created approval request with approval_request_id, current state, and notification targets.

functions.name: submit_incident_approval_decision
functions.description: Submit an approve, reject, or request-changes decision against a incident approval request.
functions.returns: Updated approval request state including quorum progress and final decision (if reached).

functions.name: add_incident_comment
functions.description: Append a comment or annotation to a incident, optionally attaching files or mentioning users.
functions.returns: The created comment object with comment_id, timestamps, and visibility-resolved permissions.

functions.name: list_incident_comments
functions.description: List comments and annotations attached to a incident, with optional thread expansion.
functions.returns: Paginated comment list with thread tree and attachment metadata.

functions.name: snapshot_incident
functions.description: Create a point-in-time immutable snapshot of a incident for forensic, rollback, or compliance use.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, checksum, byte size, and retention expiry.

functions.name: restore_incident_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a incident from a previously created snapshot, optionally as a new copy.
functions.returns: Restore job descriptor including resulting id and any per-field conflicts that were resolved.

functions.name: get_incident_metrics
functions.description: Compute KPI metrics over incidents (counts, MTTR, SLA compliance, error rates) for a time window.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Time-bucketed metric series and aggregate KPIs for the matched incidents.

functions.name: build_incident_dashboard
functions.description: Persist a named dashboard composed of widgets (charts, tables, single-stat) over incidents data.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Created dashboard descriptor with dashboard_id, shareable URL, and computed first-render preview.

functions.name: upsert_incident_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule used to govern incident behavior, validation, or routing.
functions.returns: Persisted policy with policy_id, version, rule count, and validation warnings (if any).

functions.name: list_incident_policies
functions.description: List policies governing incidents with version, scope, and lifecycle filters.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated policy entries with rule counts and last evaluation metrics.

functions.name: link_incident_dependencies
functions.description: Establish or update dependency links between a incident and related artefacts.
functions.returns: Updated dependency graph summary with added/removed/updated edges.
